description: This file defines an enumeration (enum) called CacheType used within the Apache Fineract project. It represents different cache configuration types such as invalid, no cache, single node cache, and multi-node distributed cache. The class provides methods to convert from integer values to enum instances, retrieve associated codes and values, and check cache types.

classes.name: CacheType
classes.description: An enum class representing different cache configurations used in the Fineract application. It provides utility methods for type conversion and property access.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer value to a corresponding CacheType enum instance. Returns INVALID if no matching type is found.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the CacheType instance.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the CacheType instance.

methods.name: isNoCache
methods.description: Checks if the CacheType is of type NO_CACHE.

methods.name: isEhcache
methods.description: Checks if the CacheType is of type SINGLE_NODE.

methods.name: isDistributedCache
methods.description: Checks if the CacheType is of type MULTI_NODE.
